cell_selection: nearest cell within 10 km with mean discharge >= 50% of the largest within that radius. If that river carries < 10 m3/s, the search is repeated within 20 km (status extended_search; not for sea-cooled plants); otherwise status small_stream.

status_values.ok: main river within the normal search radius
status_values.sea_cooled: plant cools with sea or estuary water (facilities.csv Water_type); river values are for reference only
status_values.extended_search: river found only within 20 km (model river displaced)
status_values.small_stream: no river >= 10 m3/s nearby: sea-, lake- or reservoir-cooled plant, or the river is missing in this model; do not use as cooling water
status_values.no_river_cell: no grid cell with discharge nearby

wt_forecast.label: Water temperature from GloFAS forecast + ECMWF HRES forecast

wt_reanalysis.label: Water temperature from GloFAS reanalysis (ERA5) + ERA5-Land

curtailment_forecast.label: Curtailment (forecast)
curtailment_forecast.inputs: discharge + water temperature of the same scenario; plant parameters from facilities.csv

curtailment_reanalysis.label: Curtailment (reanalysis)
curtailment_reanalysis.inputs: discharge + water temperature of the same scenario; plant parameters from facilities.csv
